mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and increasing the present value of future corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and residential investment signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced demand for durable goods, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 850.0 and RSAFS < 430000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 100.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% per annum during a period of stable inflation signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxy: RSAFS) combined with a drop in housing starts indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 430000.0 and HOUST < 850.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and HOUST fall below thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% combined with a rise in non-farm payroll growth above 200k signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 200.0 in the prior month
regime_hint: tight labor market with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102 (index 2017=100) during a period of rising inflation signals a supply-side shock, which increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 102.0 and CPIAUCSL > 235.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 102.0 and CPIAUCSL > 235.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered cases.
